limits: Existing teaching material/routing data is reused; no persisted business command was attempted. Twelve real POST match-preview requests are read-only evaluations.
Ordinary manager has additional non-SUPER_ADMIN roles listed here; this is an effective-actor experiment, not a single-role experiment.
All 20 originals were individually inspected. UI labels follow the selected locale; existing category, model, node and raw server diagnostic strings remain Chinese.

The mobile result table requires its own horizontal scrolling. The screenshot proves the amount, actionable Test button and MATCHED result; API assertions verify the model and route fields outside the narrow viewport.

The English desktop sidebar clips long navigation labels. Japanese and Korean tablet captures focus the match card and partially scroll the page heading under the fixed header. These images do not claim every sidebar/page label is simultaneously visible.

The new frontend defaults mobile sidebar to collapsed and keeps its toggle above the drawer. Each locale was opened/closed with native clicks before mobile rule interaction; no forced click, CSS injection or mocked response.
The previously recorded supply-chain commands and receipts retain their original timestamps and runtime identities. This supplement does not replay approvals, quotations, orders or receipts.
Human translation review is pending and is independent of agent visual inspection.
